text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh no! I'm really sorry about that! I must not be focusing enough to have yawned!
choice_data_list: Is something wrong? You seem tired.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… Well… I was up all night yesterday self-reflecting in my head.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm trying to understand why I'm always tripping in hallways, falling down stairs, and sliding into triple backflips down ramps…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: There was so much to reflect on, I continued well until morning… I'm really sorry I let this happen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like Meisho Doto hasn't gotten enough sleep.
